values.task_boundary: Local production and validation of ten complete episode packages; no hosting, directory, mailbox, provider, deployment, or launch action.
deliverables: Ten final MP3 and archive-audio artifacts with manifests
Validated local feed and enclosure parity records
Audio, redaction, rights, guest, metadata, listen-check, and package QA
Integrated ten-package proof and handoff to #262
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: All ten episodes contain complete source packet, script, transcript, show notes, metadata, artwork, audio, manifests, enclosure, redaction, QA, and review artifacts.
AC-2: Audio digests, bytes, duration, sample rate, channels, loudness, peak, ID3/artwork, listen check, and archive records are internally consistent.
AC-3: Local feed/enclosure parity rejects local or preview URLs, drafts, unstable GUIDs, missing bytes, and MIME, duration, or digest mismatch without publishing.
AC-4: Guest consent, source rights, credentials, synthetic-voice provenance, and redaction remain truthful and privacy-safe.

AC-5: Exact-head editorial/audio review and integrated ten-package validation have no unresolved actionable findings, and #342 performs no deployment, production route/storage mutation, directory submission, mailbox verification, or public-launch action.

AC-6: Before bind, preparation proves canonical #342 identity, current #51/#261/#262/#19 dependency boundaries, exact collision gates, initialized/unbound lifecycle truth, and the honest zero-complete, one-preserved-candidate, nine-absent package denominator without claiming AC-1 through AC-5.
dependencies: Final #261 identity/artwork/metadata inputs must be available before integrated completion
Exact route/storage ownership must be allocated to #262 before bind
Closed #19 preview evidence is read-only and independent
non_goals: Final show-identity or artwork-rights decision owned by #261
Production hosting, RSS, enclosures, byte-range, or live playback owned by #262
Claiming guest acceptance, live unscripted dialogue, weekly cadence, or public route without proof
